rows.label: English
rows.description: West Germanic language
rows.hook: is the main working language of aviation, business and the internet worldwide

rows.label: Spanish
rows.description: Romance language originating in the Iberian Peninsula
rows.hook: is the official language across most of Latin America as well as Spain

rows.label: Japanese
rows.description: language spoken in East Asia
rows.hook: is written using characters borrowed from Chinese alongside two native syllabaries

rows.label: French
rows.description: Romance language
rows.hook: is famous as the language of romance, fashion and diplomacy

rows.label: Tamil
rows.description: Dravidian language native to South India and Sri Lanka
rows.hook: is one of the world's oldest languages still in everyday use, spoken across southern India and Sri Lanka

rows.label: Russian
rows.description: East Slavic language
rows.hook: is written in the Cyrillic alphabet and spoken across much of Eastern Europe and Central Asia

rows.label: Urdu
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language spoken in South Asia
rows.hook: is closely related to another major South Asian language but written in a Perso-Arabic script

rows.label: Arabic
rows.description: Semitic language and lingua franca of the Arab world
rows.hook: is the language of the Quran and is spoken across the Middle East and North Africa

rows.label: Telugu
rows.description: Dravidian language native to South India
rows.hook: is a classical South Indian language known for its smooth, rounded-looking script

rows.label: Bangla
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language mostly spoken in Bangladesh and India
rows.hook: is the national language of Bangladesh and is also widely spoken in eastern India

rows.label: Malayalam
rows.description: Dravidian language of Southern India
rows.hook: is famous for its own name being spelled the same forwards and backwards

rows.label: Italian
rows.description: Romance language
rows.hook: is the language most associated with opera and classical music terminology

rows.label: Portuguese
rows.description: Western Romance language
rows.hook: is the official language of both a European country and the largest country in South America

rows.label: Mandarin
rows.description: major branch of Chinese spoken across most of northern and southwestern China
rows.hook: is written with thousands of characters and uses tones to tell similar-sounding words apart

rows.label: Indonesian
rows.description: official language of Indonesia
rows.hook: grew out of a simplified trade tongue that became the unifying language of a vast archipelago nation

rows.label: Pashto
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language of Afghanistan and Pakistan
rows.hook: is spoken by ethnic groups on both sides of the border between two Central and South Asian countries

rows.label: Vietnamese
rows.description: Austroasiatic language originating in Vietnam
rows.hook: is written with the Latin alphabet plus added tone marks, unlike most of its neighboring languages

rows.label: Burmese
rows.description: Sino-Tibetan language of Myanmar
rows.hook: is written in a script made up almost entirely of circular-looking letters

rows.label: Punjabi
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language spoken in the Punjab region of Pakistan and India
rows.hook: is a tonal language spoken across a fertile region split between two South Asian countries

rows.label: Polish
rows.description: West Slavic language
rows.hook: is a West Slavic language known for its consonant clusters and complex grammar

rows.label: Marathi
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language
rows.hook: is spoken across a large western Indian state that includes the country's financial capital city

rows.label: Gujarati
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language that is spoken in the Indian state of Gujarat
rows.hook: is spoken in a western Indian state known for its business community and vegetarian cuisine

rows.label: Yoruba
rows.description: Niger-Congo language spoken in West Africa
rows.hook: is spoken by tens of millions across a West African nation and its diaspora, with a rich oral poetry tradition

rows.label: Javanese
rows.description: Austronesian language
rows.hook: is spoken by the largest ethnic group on one of the most populous islands in the world

rows.label: Odia
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language
rows.hook: is the official language of a state on India's eastern coast

rows.label: Bhojpuri
rows.description: Indo-Aryan language native to India and Nepal
rows.hook: travelled from India to the Caribbean and Pacific with indentured labourers and is still spoken there today

rows.label: Hakka Chinese
rows.description: primary branch of Chinese originating in Southern China
rows.hook: is named after a word meaning 'guest', since its speakers migrated far from their original homeland

rows.label: Yue Chinese
rows.description: primary branch of Chinese spoken in southern China
rows.hook: is the branch spoken in Hong Kong and much of the south, historically known abroad as Cantonese
